verdict.rationale: Fastmail has its own first-party help article titled "Searching your mail", so mail search is a documented feature. The pack gives only the title, though, with no detail on operators, filters, ranking, or full-history scope. One hands-on community report says search was much slower than Gmail's, which undercuts the 'fast' part of the story. missing for 10: documented search operators/syntax, filter facets, relevance-ranked results, confirmation of full-history indexing, and evidence of fast search performance.

support.subject: As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history
